Beast Mastery Combat Styles

Choose Beast combat perks to shape your active beast's commands, attacks, and defenses.

Beast Mastery - Training

Training includes taming, calling, reviving, and directing beasts, with command perks that can add attacks or support effects.

Beast - Damage

Damage perks add physical attacks and effects such as Bleed to your beast's next strikes.

Beast - Tank

Tank perks include damage reduction and commands that draw an enemy's attention to your beast.

Beast - Balanced

Balanced perks mix beast attacks and sustained combat bonuses.

Beast - Bruiser

Bruiser perks include cone attacks and other beast attacks that can apply conditions.

Beast - Evasion

Evasion perks improve your beast's evasion and pair attacks with defensive windows.

Beast - Force

Force perks add Force damage and healing options to your beast's commands.
